name: Mason Jennings
source: Childhood Crush's look is determined by the player. Regardless of the choice, he wears a red and cream jacket with the letter "E" printed on the right side of the jacket, a gray t-shirt, and dark blue jeans. His new cologne is a fancy French one called Vetyver.
